<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Iftekhar Chowdhury Araf</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--card:rgba(255,255,255,.86);--line:rgba(20,40,90,.1);--tx:#10213f;--mut:#51628a;--blue:#1d9bf0;--grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#1d9bf0,#7c5cff,#ff4fa3,#ffb020);box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{font-family:'Poppins',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--tx);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;padding:44px 10px 64px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#d9f7ff,#e8ffe9,#fff2c9,#ffdcee,#e6dcff,#d9f7ff);background-size:400% 400%;background-color:#e8fff4;animation:bg 18s ease infinite}
@keyframes bg{50%{background-position:100% 50%}}
.orb{position:fixed;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);opacity:.4;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;animation:fl 9s ease-in-out infinite}
.o1{width:300px;height:300px;background:#ff8ac4;top:12%;left:-110px}
.o2{width:280px;height:280px;background:#5fd7ff;bottom:6%;right:-100px;animation-delay:-4s}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translateY(-40px)}}
main{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.ring{width:220px;height:220px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:50%;padding:7px;background:conic-gradient(#1d9bf0,#7c5cff,#ff4fa3,#ffb020,#22d3a0,#1d9bf0);animation:sp 7s linear infinite;box-shadow:0 14px 50px rgba(124,92,255,.45)}
.ring div{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;padding:5px;animation:sp 7s linear infinite reverse}
.ring img{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 20%;display:block}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
h1{margin-top:28px;font-size:clamp(15px,5.7vw,40px);letter-spacing:-.3px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%;padding:12px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16235f,#4b2fb8 60%,#c2308a);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(75,47,184,.35)}
h1 svg{width:1.15em;height:1.15em;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(29,155,240,.8))}
.sub{margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut)}
.tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin:30px 0 22px;padding:6px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:30px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(40,70,140,.12)}
.tabs button{flex:1;font:800 clamp(16px,4.8vw,22px)/1.2 'Poppins',system-ui,sans-serif;padding:16px 6px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--mut);cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.tabs button:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}
.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(124,92,255,.35)}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.list{display:grid;gap:13px;text-align:left;animation:pop .35s ease}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}}
.gt{text-align:left;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);margin:10px 4px 0}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:14px 16px;width:100%;font:inherit;text-align:left;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(40,70,140,.1);color:inherit;text-decoration:none;cursor:default;transition:.2s}
a.row,button.row{cursor:pointer}
.row:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--c)}
.ic{flex:none;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 16%,#fff);box-shadow:0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 30%,transparent)}
.ic svg{width:25px;height:25px;fill:none;stroke:var(--c);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.t{min-width:0}.t small{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut)}.t b{display:block;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.about{text-align:left;padding:26px 22px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(40,70,140,.12);animation:pop .35s ease}
.about h3{font-size:clamp(20px,5.6vw,26px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.3}
.about p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:14px}
.about .tag{margin:20px 0 0;font-size:clamp(16px,4.6vw,20px);font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;animation:pop .35s ease}
.ph{padding:0;border:5px solid #fff;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;aspect-ratio:3/4;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(40,70,140,.22);transition:.25s}
.ph:nth-child(even){transform:rotate(1.4deg)}.ph:nth-child(odd){transform:rotate(-1.4deg)}
.ph:hover{transform:scale(1.03)}
.ph.w{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:4/3;transform:none}
.ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 25%;display:block}
#lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(10,15,40,.9);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px;cursor:zoom-out}
#lb img{max-width:100%;max-height:88vh;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,120px);background:#16235f;color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;transition:transform .3s;z-index:9}
#toast.on{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
footer{margin-top:36px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important}}
</style></head><body>
